name: Furnal Equinox
blurb: Canada's largest furry convention, held over the Spring Equinox weekend in Toronto, now at the Sheraton Centre.

editions.evidence: Homepage countdown: 'February 13 - 15, 2027'; venue confirmed on the Hotel & Travel page: 'Our wonderful new venue, the Sheraton Centre Toronto... 123 Queen St W Toronto, Ontario M5H 2M9'

notes: Each Guest of Honour (Chise, Amyte) has a multi-photo gallery on the guests page (4 and 3 images respectively); one representative photo per person was picked rather than every image. Venue change to the Sheraton Centre Toronto for 2027 confirmed on-site.
